followup_figure.horizontal_axis: time step t, predictions commencing at t=32
followup_figure.note: The figure is the open-loop diagnostic, matching the 368-step construction above -- not the 100-step imagination rollout. So the follow-up's uncertainty evidence is itself gathered at a horizon 3.68x longer than the one its method deploys at. We report that as an observation about the original, not as a defect: a diagnostic may legitimately run past the deployment horizon. What it does mean is that OUR h=368 is comparable to the original's figure, while our h=100 is comparable to the original's method.
followup_figure.plotted_horizon: not stated numerically in either version; the axis is a time index and no rollout length is given in the caption or in §5.1
